appliedUpdates.description: Fixed import from requests to httpx to match available dependencies
Fixed mock patch to use httpx.get instead of requests.get
Fixed rate limiting test to call _apply_rate_limit() twice to test actual delay
Fixed overlap calculation to only include new content (from current_idx to end_idx) in overlap, not the overlap portion from previous chunk

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: When 'exactly' is specified in requirements (e.g., 'exactly 50 tokens'), tests should use strict equality, not tolerance. The test_overlap_50_tokens test used abs(overlap - 50) <= 5 which masked the bug.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: tests/test_chunker.py line 61: assert abs(overlap_tokens - 50) <= 5 - this tolerance allowed the overlap bug to pass initial validation

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update skill to acknowledge that httpx is a valid alternative to wikipedia-api when timeout issues occur. The worker made a justified deviation switching to httpx due to wikipedia-api search timeouts.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: scrape-wikipedia-articles feature: Worker switched from wikipedia-api to httpx due to timeout issues, but maintained all functional requirements
